categories.evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp to throw runtime exceptions on disk read errors and index corruption instead of returning null.
categories.rationale: TxIndex previously returned empty results on corruption and I/O failures, silently returning false negatives rather than reporting an internal failure. As noted in commit fa5c96a112, index corruption should notify the caller properly rather than returning false negatives.

categories.rationale: RPC and REST endpoints falsely reported confirmed transactions as missing whenever filesystem errors or index lookups failed. Surfacing internal errors rather than returning 'No such transaction found' prevents client applications from drawing incorrect conclusions about transaction presence.
